breaking.change: Fallback adapters present WebGPU-rendered frames through a single asynchronous CPU readback to the canvas, avoiding unsupported compositor swap-image sharing. Hardware adapters retain surface presentation. The first-frame mark now waits for a complete presented frame in autoplay too. A replacement device must remain healthy before its recovery deadline resets.
breaking.fix: No game changes are required. Leave pipeline mode on auto; fallback adapters continue using asynchronous compilation. The play gate deliberately holds simulation until play; autoplay ticks do not wait for renderer readiness.
